verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a feedback widget, routing of submissions into projects or the organization's Feedback list, and spam triage. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to reply to the submitting customer from the feedback record or otherwise close the loop with them. Replying to customers is a fair axis for a product that collects user feedback, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop
